title: Request an environmental health officer
description: Request an environmental health officer to attend an event where food or drink is served to the public.

config.subject: Your request for an environmental health officer has been received
A new request for an environmental health officer has been received

steps.title: Are you operating a temporary restaurant?

overrides.label: Are you operating a temporary restaurant (serving food) at this event?
overrides.hint: A temporary restaurant is any set-up serving food or drink to the public for 30 days or less. If you are serving food, you also need a temporary restaurant licence — we will collect that in this same form.

required.error: Select whether you are operating a temporary restaurant at this event

overrides.content: Because you are serving food, this request also includes your application for a temporary restaurant licence. We will ask about the food you serve and your food-safety arrangements.
You **do not need** to fill out a separate temporary restaurant licence form.

overrides.label: Mobile number
overrides.hint: We will use your mobile number to contact you. For example, (246) 249 1234.

overrides.label: Email address
overrides.hint: We will use this to contact you about your request. For example, you@example.com.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.description: Review all the information you have provided before submitting your request.

options.label: I confirm that my information is correct and I am happy for it to be verified. I understand that false details may lead to my application being rejected, and that the Government of Barbados will keep my information confidential.

required.error: You must confirm the declaration to continue

options.label: I will operate the temporary restaurant in accordance with the Health Services (Restaurants) Regulations, 1969.

required.error: You must confirm you will follow the temporary restaurant regulations to continue

options.label: I understand that the event organiser is responsible for the overtime costs of the environmental health officers who provide public health surveillance and inspection during the event.

required.error: You must confirm you understand the overtime costs to continue

steps.title: Request submitted
steps.markdownContent:
A copy of your request has been sent to the email address you gave and to the Environmental Health Department at **{polyclinic}**.

## What happens next

- The Environmental Health Department at **{polyclinic}** will review your request.
- Environmental health officers will attend on the dates and times you gave. The department will confirm arrangements and any overtime costs.
- If there are overtime costs, they will send an invoice after the request is approved. The fees are payable in advance to the Accountant General.
- If you are also operating a temporary restaurant, this request includes your licence application. An officer checks your set-up and issues the licence at the event, not in advance. It is valid for 30 days from the date it is issued.

Keep your reference number for any follow-up.
